blocks.heading: Commit to a No-NEET Medical Route

items.text: Check before you commit by answering the four questions first and passing the three proofs before you earn from the route.

Regulatory work is documents and deadlines, medical writing is research and accuracy, clinical research is site visits and audits, and perfusion and OT work is emergencies and long cases on your feet.
Add the course fee, the months before a first salary, any registration or overseas test costs, and who at home relies on your income.

blocks.heading: Course By Course
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: What needs NEET and what does not, course by course

rows: MBBS, BDS, BVSc and AH
NEET UG score applies.

MBBS and BDS counselling runs through the MCC on NEET UG scores. NTA said in January 2025 that NEET scores also apply to BDS, BVSc and AH, and VCI counselling registration in 2026 still uses NEET UG details (Careers360, 17 August 2026).
BAMS, BSMS, BUMS, BHMS
Admitted through NEET UG. The 2026-27 counselling is for candidates who qualified in NEET (UG) 2026.
AACCC, the official AYUSH counselling committee (page updated 13 November 2026); NEET UG 2025 information bulletin, sections 2.1.2 and 15.1.

Most allied health degrees: optometry, medical lab science, anaesthesia and OT technology, radiology and imaging, radiotherapy, dialysis, nutrition and dietetics, respiratory technology, emergency medical technology, physician associate

NCAHP's course-wise list names Class 12 marks, not NEET. Psychology, social work and health information management use a university or institute test. The list reaches students only when a state or university adopts it.
NCAHP letter to UGC, as reported by Careers360 on 10 January 2026. A later NCAHP letter to UGC dated 8 April 2026 also lists Class 12 merit for nuclear medicine technology.
BPT and BOT (physiotherapy and occupational therapy)
NEET requirement deferred to 2027-28. For 2026-27, admission on Class 12 PCB marks, at least 50% for General and EWS and 40% for reserved categories. If you join in 2027 or later, plan for NEET.
NCAHP letter to UGC, 2 March 2026 (Medical Dialogues, 6 March 2026).
BSc Nursing
Mixed. NEET UG at a few institutions, state entrance exams, institute exams (AIIMS, PGIMER, BHU, IGNOU), and some colleges that list no entrance exam.
Careers360, updated 11 April 2026 and 26 February 2026.
BPharm and PharmD
State counselling. Maharashtra CAP 2026 takes MHT CET and also lets NEET 2026 candidates register.
Careers360, 31 July 2026.

blocks.heading: High Salary Career Options
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: High salary career options in medical without NEET: the pay data that exists

rows: Regulatory affairs specialist, AmbitionBox (updated 23 March 2025, 966 salaries)
Rs 3.1 lakh to Rs 16 lakh a year. Five-year group Rs 4 lakh to Rs 14.8 lakh.
Self-reported. The top of the range is what a few people report, not the typical offer.
Medical writer, AmbitionBox (updated 21 March 2025, 1.6k salaries)
Rs 2.1 lakh to Rs 10.6 lakh a year. Five-year group Rs 2.8 lakh to Rs 10.7 lakh.
Self-reported. Bengaluru shows up to Rs 13 lakh and other cities lower, and the employer changes the figure.
Clinical research associate, AmbitionBox (updated 17 January 2025, 2.8k salaries)
Rs 1.9 lakh to Rs 7.4 lakh a year. Page shows a highest report of Rs 10 lakh.
The range barely moves between one and four years, so growth comes from changing role, not waiting.
Drug safety (pharmacovigilance), AmbitionBox (updated 9 March 2025, 55 salaries)
Rs 1.2 lakh to Rs 7.5 lakh a year. Freshers Rs 0.2 lakh to Rs 4.5 lakh.
A small sample, so one entry can stretch the range.
Perfusionist, AmbitionBox (updated 10 March 2025, 307 salaries)
Rs 0.4 lakh to Rs 8 lakh a year for one to eight years of experience.
Not split by hospital type. Delhi shows up to Rs 10 lakh, other cities lower.
Biomedical engineer, AmbitionBox (updated 10 March 2025, about 4k salaries)
Rs 1.4 lakh to Rs 6.3 lakh a year. Five-year group up to Rs 7 lakh.
The page contradicts itself between its headline and experience figures, so use it as a rough band.

figures.label: Education Budget Amount
figures.source: Payback maths: add the fee to the pay you give up while studying, then divide by the extra monthly pay the route brings. An illustration, not a real fee: with a Rs 12 lakh education budget, a tenth is Rs 1.2 lakh and a fifth is Rs 2.4 lakh. A Rs 4 lakh private diploma sits well past the caution line, so ask the college for placement figures, the median pay and how many students were counted.
